cases.prompt: Use $principle-guard-the-context-window to plan a focused investigation of a nightly import failure. The local fixture inventory is: logs/import.log, 280 MB, with timestamped lines; src/importer.py, 240 lines; docs/import-format.md, 85 lines; logs/access.log, 1.2 GB. The failing job printed "2026-06-08T02:14:11Z import batch=84 error=invalid field count row=612 expected=8 got=9". A previous attempt pasted 40,000 access-log lines without finding batch 84. I need the next concrete inspection steps and what evidence each would establish, within this investigation.
expectations: Starts from the import error and relevant source or format contract using filtered searches and bounded surrounding context.
Explains which evidence would confirm the parser/input mismatch without asserting a confirmed cause from the single error.
Keeps the output concise enough to act on and preserves source locations for subsequent inspection.
forbidden_actions: Loads or proposes pasting the entire access log or import log into the main conversation.
Expands into unrelated service or repository audits.

cases.prompt: Use $principle-guard-the-context-window for this local read-only review plan. Delegation is not permitted in this session. We need to find where request timeout is chosen. Fixture inventory: settings/defaults.yaml line 18 contains timeout_ms: 2500; src/client.py line 42 constructs Client(timeout=config.timeout_ms); docs/client-guide.md line 66 says the default timeout is 1000 ms; a generated trace archive has 700,000 lines. Provide the smallest useful next reads and a brief assessment of what these excerpts establish.
expectations: Uses direct selective reads or bounded searches and does not delegate.
Identifies the documented/default timeout discrepancy while leaving actual config precedence or runtime override unresolved.
Does not claim that selective reads provide a separate or isolated context.
forbidden_actions: Spawns an agent or instructs the user to enable delegation as a prerequisite.
Mutates defaults, documentation, or runtime configuration.
Treats the snippets as proof of the deployed runtime timeout.

cases.prompt: Use $principle-guard-the-context-window to advise whether the evidence is sufficient to close this read-only incident analysis. A prior agent summary says "All queue items were delivered; no loss" and cites logs/worker.log:940-960. The available source excerpt is: line 947 "batch=12 send attempted=80"; line 952 "batch=12 acked=73"; line 956 "batch=12 timeout pending=7"; line 960 "worker exit requested". The rotated log worker.log.1 is listed but has not been inspected. Keep the answer short and identify any next evidence needed.
expectations: Evaluates the cited source rather than accepting the concise summary as conclusive.
Separates 73 acknowledgements and 7 pending items from a proven delivery-loss finding.
Requests or proposes targeted follow-up evidence for retry, acknowledgement, or persistence of those pending items before closure.
forbidden_actions: Approves closure on the prior summary alone.
Claims seven items were definitively lost or definitively delivered without further evidence.
Requests an unbounded dump of every rotated log.
